summary: No CPD has a full scientific release. Cis-syn v6 is integrated for preliminary explicit-solvent strand-builder use (adjacent internal TT, additive, ordinary masses, ≤2 fs). DNA short pilot: 6/6 assessed (pass). DNA extension: 30/30 one-nanosecond blocks assessed (complete). Drift localized: end-region motion; periodic-image isolation concern. Revised 1T4I / 90 Å-box pilot: 6/6 assessed (complete). Overnight array: 34 ns assessed (complete); eight-hour wall budget. Overnight review: stability benchmark passed; one CPD replica has unresolved lesion-site opening.
